blurb: Stoneboat Vineyards is a family-owned winery committed to crafting traditional Okanagan wines that showcase the unique qualities of the Okanagan Valley terroir. Their portfolio includes estate, small-lot, and reserve wines such as Pinot Noir, Pinotage, Pinot Gris, Rosé, and Sparkling Wine. The vineyard is located on the Black Sage benchlands in Oliver, BC.
